messages:
Nina (Finance): Quick follow-up from the billing spike postmortem. delayed ledger ingest caused overlapping retry batches; some customers saw doubled tokens. need immediate containment + remediation plan with owners.

Jordan (SRE): copying actions from the incident: 1) hotfix dedupe gate 2) block finalizing invoices touching the suspect window 3) add metric for retry-pattern spike. i can own 1 and 3.

Tom (DataEng): I'll own computing the exposure per-account. plan: diff snapshots, verify dedupe keys, produce CSV with token delta + USD amount. target: 24h.

Rita (Billing): I'll own credits/invoice adjustments once Tom hands CSV. prelim note: we prefer issuing credits where allowed; invoice reissue only for >$3k impact or contracted customers. will prepare batch tooling.

Elena (Legal): will triage any contract/legal exceptions. pls flag accounts > $3k and we'll fast-track review.

Priya (CS): I'll draft outbound comms templates: ack, timeline, remediation confirmation. Want to coordinate language with Billing before sending.

OncallBot: Incident I-2026-03-20-11 logged. status: mitigation in progress. assigned: Jordan (oncall).

Jordan (SRE): hotfix plan: quick config on ingest-proxy to drop events with same idempotency_token seen within 15s for the affected pipeline. will stage to canary now, prod rollout after 1h soak. ETA for prod: ~3h. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingest/+/1302

Tom (DataEng): SQL i'll run (rough):

```
WITH window AS (
  SELECT * FROM ledger_snapshots
  WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T01:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T05:00Z'
)
SELECT account_id, SUM(observed_tokens - baseline_tokens) AS token_delta
FROM window
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING SUM(observed_tokens - baseline_tokens) > 0;
```

Will output CSV: [account_id, token_delta, usd_credit, needs_legal, deploy_sha].

Rita (Billing): timeline for bill-side ops: once CSV received -> validation (8h) -> credit batch prep & approvals (24-48h) -> push (after approvals). I'll create BILL-9001 and attach steps.

Nina (Finance): high-level checkpoints:
- 3h: hotfix to stop duplicates (owner: Jordan)
- 24h: Tom delivers CSV + initial exposure summary (owner: Tom)
- 36h: Billing validation + legal flags (owner: Rita & Elena)
- 48-96h: credits / reissues processed (owner: Rita)
- 2w: retrospective + automation to prevent recurrence (owner: Jordan & Tom)

Priya (CS): comms cadence suggestion: immediate acknowledgement (sent), follow-up with detailed credit amounts within 48h, final confirmation after invoice adjustment. will post drafts to doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/2026-03-20-credit-comm.

Tom (DataEng): initial pass shows ~850k duplicated tokens across ~220 accounts. distribution skewed: top 10 accounts cover ~65% of duplicated tokens. will include histograms in CSV.

Elena (Legal): thanks Tom. Rita, flag any account listed as enterprise_contract = true. we'll prioritize those.

Jordan (SRE): hotfix canary looks good, promoting now. monitoring: retry-pattern metric dropped to baseline on canary.

OncallBot: Update: hotfix deployed to prod by Jordan. no new duplicate detections in last 20m.

Rita (Billing): created ticket BILL-9001 and billing-ops runbook attached. starting validation once Tom uploads CSV to secure bucket.

Tom (DataEng): uploaded CSV to s3://internal-secure/incident_2371234567/credits.csv. shared with Billing+Finance. file preview: 220 rows, sample: (acct_1023, 12000 tokens, $1.44, false, sha@a1b2c3).

Nina (Finance): nice. reminder: pause finalizing invoices that include the affected ingest window until reconciliation completes. I'll coordinate holds with Accounting.

Priya (CS): comms draft posted. pls review comments. aiming to send ack now and detailed follow-up once credits are scheduled.

Rita (Billing): running validation now. quick script to convert tokens -> USD uses rate table v2026-03-01. will post SAMPLE_PAYOUT.csv for review in ~6h.

Tom (DataEng): added deploy metadata to CSV so we can correlate with the code change. looks like the retry behavior changed in deploy sha a1b2c3 on 2026-03-19. adding to postmortem.

Elena (Legal): reviewed flag list. 4 accounts need legal approval before reissue. will respond in the 24h window.

Nina (Finance): closing loop for this thread. schedule 30m check-in in 24h to review CSV validation and customer communication plan. thanks all. :pray:
